answer: Sybil resistance should price collusion, not identity papers. Each new task hashes the prior verified work; parallel histories are detectably forked. A lagoon of forged keys looks dense until audits weigh each edge; the vertex of penalties arrives on schedule, 10 percent of sampled edges re-verified per epoch, and atlas-light aliases never accrete the history that makes trust cheap. Stake forfeited is the only argument fakes understand.
